prompt: Photograph a figure outside a shuttered shop at night, taken with a cheap disposable camera and its direct flash, framed off-centre with a wet bin lid blurred in the near corner. He stands chest-up beside a launderette window where a small television plays the news to nobody, and he is pointing at it with one gloved hand. His whole head is in a white knitted balaclava with no eye or mouth holes; a thin black ring is stitched around the face, and high inside it, over one eye, a small red triangle with rounded corners. A black parka zipped to the chin, hood down, black leather gloves. The flash flattens the white wool to near-featureless, catches rain on his shoulders, and the street behind falls to near-black. Slight motion blur, cool green cast, harsh grain. Thanks.
